pages.text: $(o)Chief of the masked Umvuthana, holding court in a grove of the savanna.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() He heals all fight long and hides behind his followers. Clear the masks around him, then keep every blade on him so the healing never catches up.$(br2)Sunfire lands where you stand. Keep moving.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Sunbird Plume$() counts for the quest book.
